newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit says no plan to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit says no plan to hold news conference.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it has no plans to hold a news conference, contrary to vague rumours in the financial markets that it might hold an emergency media briefing.
A bank official told Reuters that the bank has no plan now to hold an emergency news conference but it is preparing to issue a comment on its falling share price. He did not elaborate.
Japanese government bond prices soared in Tokyo morning trade on the vague talk of a news conference as early as today.

Active sales pushed Nippon Credit Bank's shares down 26 yen to 190 yen in Tokyo morning trade to their lowest level for the current financial year. The level was lower than the shares' previous 1996/97 low of 210 yen marked on January 29, 1997.
